title: Experience the Full Power of Spyglass
summary: The powerful Spyglass tool has officially transitioned from beta, bringing its advanced capabilities to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management and Display
summary: Our latest update empowers you to effortlessly manage, upload, and customize how all your files appear directly within the editor, providing a seamless and tailored content creation experience.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: We've launched a new dedicated roadmap page on our website, making it easier than ever for you to track our progress, see what's coming next, and discover our future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more seamless experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and visually integrated into the modern design.

title: Improved Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a significantly improved collaboration environment that makes working with others more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared projects and ideas, as all relevant content from your network now appears directly within your search results and dedicated shared views.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce robust international language support, making our platform accessible to a worldwide audience.

title: Noeko is Officially Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, involvement, and transparency in its future development.

title: Advanced Filters for Your Interactive Knowledge Graph
summary: Empower your knowledge graph with advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared content, making it an indispensable tool for seamless exploration and powerful workflow initiation.

title: Precision Search and Curated Knowledge
summary: Unlock your full knowledge base with powerful filtering and sorting tools, empowering you to effortlessly create and revisit personalized collections of information.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Discover new, flexible ways to display and interact with your linked content, making it easier to visualize and organize your thoughts effectively.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting and Flexible Cloud Plans
summary: We're excited to launch Noeko with new self-hosting capabilities and flexible cloud-hosted plans, empowering you with greater control and choice for your projects.

title: Elevate Your Style with New Themes
summary: Prepare to transform your workspace with beautifully updated themes and an exciting selection of brand-new styles designed just for you.

title: Your Welcome, Always Right on Time
summary: Experience a warm and accurate welcome every time you log in, as we fine-tune our greetings to perfectly match your current time of day.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
